description: Fleet-wide M365 backup assurance for SkyKick Cloud Backup - posture, stale snapshots, and coverage gaps no portal or wrapper can show.

novel_features.name: Fleet sync
novel_features.description: One command pulls every subscription plus per-tenant settings, retention, autodiscover, snapshot stats, mailboxes, sites, and alerts into the local SQLite fleet store.

novel_features.name: Fleet health posture
novel_features.description: One cross-tenant protection posture table - every subscription's Exchange/SharePoint enablement, retention, autodiscover, and last-backup age with gap flags.

novel_features.name: Stale snapshots
novel_features.description: Every mailbox not snapshotted within N hours, fleet-wide.

novel_features.name: Coverage gaps
novel_features.description: Discovered-but-unprotected mailboxes and SharePoint sites per tenant.

novel_features.name: Fleet alert sweep
novel_features.description: One ranked list of open alerts across the whole fleet, with optional bulk mark-complete.

novel_features.name: Retention compliance audit
novel_features.description: Grades each tenant's retention period against a compliance floor you set.

novel_features.name: Autodiscover audit
novel_features.description: Fleet table of autodiscover on/off state per tenant.

novel_features.name: Watch async operation
novel_features.description: Polls an async operation to a terminal state with backoff in one command.

novel_features.name: Protection drift
novel_features.description: Diffs two sync snapshots and reports protection-state changes since last sync.

novel_features.name: Partner roll-up
novel_features.description: Protection posture aggregated by partner for distributor oversight.
